messages.label: Checking part isolation and construction detail

reference.construction: Tall, soft-sided collar, narrower at the opening and flaring toward a curved base.
reference.texture: Fine, broadly smooth fabric surface; no clearly defined ribbing. Inner surface texture is ambiguous.
reference.opening: Visible rear rim and a lower, curved front rim. Inward folds beside the front opening create an uneven, softly collapsed edge.
reference.height: Substantial rise above the neckline, with the rear and side edges higher than the dipped front opening.
reference.attachment: Broad curved attachment at the collar base, lowest at the front center and rising toward both sides.
reference.seams: Narrow, closely spaced seam or stitch lines follow the curved base. Individual stitch construction is ambiguous; no distinct vertical collar seam is clearly visible.

analysis.name: High stand mock-neck collar
analysis.construction: Tall, smooth-knit collar with no clearly defined ribs. Narrows toward the opening from a broad, curved neckline attachment. The unfastened opening has a soft rounded edge, dipping at the front with asymmetric inward folds rather than a turned-down cuff. Two closely spaced stitch rows follow the curved attachment seam at the base. No separate binding or collar panel joins are clearly visible.
